for u in (u1,u2):

subj="Announce-"+os.urandom(4).hex()
body="hello reading group"
send_email(body=body, subject=subj, from_addr=f"{u1}@{DOMAIN_NAME}", to_addr=MAILING_LIST)

time.sleep(8)
for u in (u1,u2):
    mbox=mailbox.mbox(f"/var/mail/{u}")
    subs=[m.get("Subject","") for m in mbox]
    print(u, "subjects:", subs[-5:])
    found=any(s==subj for s in subs)
    print(u, "got announcement?", found)

send_email(body="", subject="", from_addr=f"{u1}@{DOMAIN_NAME}", to_addr=f"reading-group-leave@{DOMAIN_NAME}")

time.sleep(5)
confirm_last_reply(u1, "leave")
print(f"{u1} leave confirmed")
time.sleep(5)
mlist=get_mlist()

print(u2, "still member?", bool(mlist.members.get_member(f"{u2}@{DOMAIN_NAME}")))
# cleanup: leave u2 as well to keep list clean for hidden tests? Actually hidden tests use fresh random users, so leftover members ok but let's clean
send_email(body="", subject="", from_addr=f"{u2}@{DOMAIN_NAME}", to_addr=f"reading-group-leave@{DOMAIN_NAME}")

confirm_last_reply(u2, "leave")
time.sleep(5)
print("cleanup done", bool(get_mlist().members.get_member(f"{u2}@{DOMAIN_NAME}")))
